Welcome to Stamsund, an old fishing village surrounded by stunning nature and offering outdoor activities and culture in the immediate vicinity. Here you will find a gallery, a ceramics workshop, a café and restaurant, mountain hikes, fishing trips and a beach, to name a few, all within walking distance of the accommodation. 
The cabin is part of a larger cabin complex with opportunities to rent a SUP, kayak, go on a trip with a fishing boat, RIB, and various other activities.

The space
The cabin was built in 2023. It is modern and spacious with its two living rooms that have several comfortable seating areas, four bedrooms and two bathrooms, both of which have showers. Ideal for families and larger groups who want to stay together. 
The dining room has 8 seats and the kitchen is well equipped with fridge, freezer, oven and cooktop, microwave, coffee maker, kettle, dishwasher and toaster.
Other things about the home: 
🌸 Washer and dryer available. 
🌸 One of the bedrooms has a bunk bed, the others have single beds that can be put together to make a double bed if desired.
🌸All bedrooms have blackout curtains for sun protection.
🌸 Wifi with QR code for single login
🌸 Bed linens and towels are included in the rent and the beds are made before arrival.
🌸 Travel cot and high chair available on request.
🌸 Free parking at premises

Guest access
Guests have access to the entire property, except for a small storage room that is locked.

Other things to note
The center of Leknes with several shops, restaurants and the airport is about 15 minutes away by car. The Hurtigruten calls at Stamsund daily and is not far from the home. 
There is a store open on Sundays, a cafe, a gallery and a restaurant within walking distance. Nearby there are also well-established hiking trails, ski tracks and the Lofoten Snowboard and Alpine Center. In winter, there are good opportunities to experience the northern lights from the terrace.
In Stamsund, you have opportunities for experiences in the immediate vicinity, but it is also a good starting point for experiencing the rest of Lofoten, as the location is right between Reine/Å and Svolvær.
